description: 美国企业高管警告特朗普政府拟议的对华500亿美元关税可能导致供应链中断、成本上升及业务被迫退出，特别是依赖中国零部件的企业面临无法短期替代的风险。

US threatens 25% tariffs on $50 billion of Chinese imports (machinery, electronics, soybeans); China threatens retaliatory tariffs on $49.8 billion of US exports (agriculture, transportation). US also considering expanding tariffs to $100 billion. This regulatory escalation poses significant risk to supply chains for intermediate goods and agricultural products.

US Congress and President Trump considering bills and executive actions to block Chinese firms from acquiring advanced US technology firms in aviation, semiconductors, biotechnology, and robotics, citing national security risks. This regulatory barrier disrupts M&A-driven supply chain integration and technology transfer.
trigger_phrases: guard against the risk to the national security
directing investment towards US high-tech companies

description: Escalating trade tension between US and China could slow economic growth in Asia Pacific and dampen business optimism, potentially leading to reduced demand and supply chain contraction in the region.
trigger_phrases: trade war will not make much progress

description: 美国宣布将于6月15日发布价值500亿美元的中国商品清单，征收25%关税，并计划实施投资限制和出口管制，涉及工业关键技术。

description: 特朗普政府计划对价值500亿美元的中国商品征收显著关税，中国威胁将迅速反击，双方贸易紧张局势升级，可能引发长期贸易战，影响包括半导体、机器人、大豆、飞机和汽车在内的多种商品供应链。

description: 美国计划于7月6日对价值340亿美元的中国商品征收关税，并可能进一步对2000亿美元商品加征关税，同时实施新的出口管制和投资限制。这可能导致中美贸易冲突升级，影响电子、消费品及汽车供应链，并引发中国报复措施。

description: 美国对价值500亿美元的中国商品征收25%关税，涉及电动汽车和航空导航设备等，已正式宣布并即将实施，导致美国买家成本上升或寻找替代供应商。
